hints.title: Single Character Edit Distance Search
hints.text: Determine whether an inquiry string can match an existing dictionary word by modifying exactly one character.

hints.title: Trie DFS with Error Budget
hints.text: Traverse the prefix tree recursively tracking remaining allowable character substitutions (initially one).

hints.title: Magic Dictionary Blueprint
hints.text: In search(word): helper dfs(node, idx, edits): if edits < 0: return False. If idx == len(word): return node.is_word and edits == 0. For ch, child in node.children: if dfs(child, idx+1, edits - (0 if ch == word[idx] else 1)) return True. Return False.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Branching occurs at only one character mismatch level, keeping search bounded by 26 * L operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 25 * L variations and looking them up takes extra hash table space and overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ensuring that exactly one character is modified (edits must equal zero at completion, not untouched).
